200.answer: Yes, One Bill combines all your Bell services into one simple summary with a detail page, so you only have one payment to make monthly. If you have not been enrolled, you can sign up in minutes. One Bill is offered to Bell Home phone customers with one or more Bell services.

snippets.text: # What is One Bill and how does it work? What is One Bill?  - expanded ## What is One Bill? One Bill combines the billing information for all your Bell services in a simple, easy-to-read summary with a detail page for each. That means there's only one payment to make each month. Eligible customers are being automatically enrolled into the One Bill program. But if you haven’t been enrolled, you can [sign up for One Bill](http://www.bell.ca/support/PrsCSrvBill_OneBill_SignUp.page)in minutes. Who can receive One Bill?  - collapsed ## Who can receive One Bill? We offer One Bill to our Bell Home phone customers with one or more Bell services. How to understand my One Bill  - collapsed
